query:
SELECT id, claim_number, pipeline_status, current_pipeline_stage, pipeline_error, pipeline_started_at, pipeline_completed_at, created_at
FROM claims
WHERE claim_number LIKE '%F75D99DD%' OR claim_number LIKE '%DOC-20260511-F75D99DD%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
